prd_facts.fact: A coupon percent must be above 0 and at most 50, otherwise a ValueError; the old limit of 100 is gone from the rule.
A coupon of exactly 50% is accepted and one above 50% is refused with a ValueError.
The VIP percentage, how the VIP and coupon percentages add up, the 30% cap, shipping, rounding and the receipt layout do not change.
Applies to every order from now on, with no flag and no migration.
